Adrion · Curated Croatia

We don’t show you Croatia.
We take you into it.

About Us

Adrion curates private multi-day journeys and day experiences across Croatia, from its landscapes and historic towns to the Adriatic coast and islands, and arranges private transfers, charters and accommodation, each available to book independently or as part of your journey.

We choose routes, local experiences and places to stay with care, paying attention to how each day unfolds. Our programmes combine cultural immersion with comfort, personal service and attention to detail.

Read our story →
Scroll to move
Journeys & Services

Your time in Croatia, carefully planned.

  • Multi-day journeys Travel through Croatia’s regions with time for local culture, regional food and the landscapes along the way. Our private programmes can be booked as presented or adapted on request. →
  • One-day experiences Spend a day on the river, follow an e-bike route or explore a historic town. Our private programmes offer a closer look at Croatia’s landscapes, local culture and food. →
  • Private transfers From the airport to your hotel, a marina or your next destination, we arrange private road and selected sea transfers. Book independently or as part of your journey. →
  • Charters Explore the Adriatic for a day or a longer stay aboard a sailing yacht, catamaran or motor yacht. Charters can be booked independently or combined with a journey on land. →
  • Accommodation Settle into a hotel or villa chosen for its location, comfort and service. We can arrange your stay independently or include it in an Adrion journey. →

Croatian Regions, Curated by Adrion

From vineyard hills and forest trails to historic towns and island shores, Croatia’s character changes with every region. Our six regional collections bring together outdoor adventure, local culture and regional food through private journeys and day experiences shaped by the landscapes and people of each place.

Hilltop Towns, Vineyards & Adriatic Islands

Istria Extended Weekend — a private curated journey

From €2,590 per person

Istria is Croatia's gentlest introduction — Roman stone, quiet hill towns and a coastline still worth slowing down for. Four days is enough to read it properly: Pula's amphitheatre and Rovinj's rooftops, an inland ride through Grožnjan and Motovun's vineyards, and

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Pula & Rovinj

    A private transfer meets you in Pula — the Arena, the Forum, the Temple of Augustus, read at an unhurried pace before lunch. The afternoon moves to Rovinj, your base for the weekend, with an easy first ride along the Zlatni Rt waterfront if you like, and a long dinner to close the day.

  2. Day 2

    Inland Istria

    E-MTBs take you inland through Grožnjan's artist lanes and along stretches of the old Parenzana railway toward Motovun, hill towns holding a wine country most visitors never see. Lunch is Istrian truffle country at its most straightforward — a konoba in Motovun's shadow — and the afternoon closes at a family winery.

  3. Day 3

    The Adriatic by boat

    A private speedboat carries you out toward Brijuni and the western coast — swimming stops, quiet coves, the Adriatic without a schedule attached to it. Lunch is at the water's edge in Fažana before the boat turns back, with an optional sunset ride along Zlatni Rt for those not ready to stop.

  4. Day 4

    Departure

    Breakfast, then — time permitting — one last unhurried stop at Poreč's Euphrasian Basilica or the ruins at Dvigrad, before your private transfer onward.

What's included

  • — Private Mercedes V-Class with driver
  • — Premium full-suspension E-MTB with full support
  • — Private speedboat day to Brijuni and the western coast
  • — Boutique winery and olive oil tastings
  • — Single-base premium stay in Rovinj
  • — End-to-end logistics and on-trip concierge
  • — All meals throughout the journey
  • — A detailed day-by-day itinerary, provided on request

Questions

+ Is the Istria Extended Weekend private?

Yes — every Adrion journey runs exclusively for your party, arranged around your dates and pace.

+ How much cycling is involved?

The E-MTB days are guided and vehicle-supported throughout; routes adjust to your group's pace and cycling is never mandatory.

+ Where does the journey begin?

With a private transfer from Pula, or another arrival point agreed in advance.

+ Can it be extended?

Yes — it combines easily with other Adrion journeys or a Kvarner extension.

Istria · Signature seven-day journey

Istria Signature Journey — a private curated journey

From €5,190 per person

Istria Signature Journey gives the peninsula its full week — two accommodation bases so nothing is rushed, two private days on the Adriatic, and a route that runs from Pula's Roman stone to the truffle oak of the interior. It is the complete version of the Istria story: coast, hill towns, wine country and the sea, worked into a single unhurried arc.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Pula & Rovinj

    A private transfer meets you in Pula for an unhurried first look at the Arena and the old town, before continuing to Rovinj — the first of two accommodation bases. An easy waterfront ride is on offer for those who want it, then a long welcome dinner.

  2. Day 2

    The west coast by bike

    E-MTBs trace the coast from Rovinj through Zlatni Rt and the Limski Canal to Bale and the ruins at Dvigrad, vehicle support shadowing the whole route. Lunch and a winery visit close the day at a proper Istrian pace.

  3. Day 3

    Brijuni by boat

    A private speedboat opens the Brijuni archipelago and the Fažana Channel — swimming, quiet coves, an unhurried lunch on the water, with a curated olive oil tasting folded into the afternoon.

  4. Day 4

    Into central Istria

    The journey turns inland: a signature ride through Grožnjan's artist lanes and the old Parenzana railway toward Motovun, where your second base — deeper in wine country — waits above the hill towns.

  5. Day 5

    Truffles, Hum & Buzet

    A morning truffle hunt with a family of hunters and their dogs, then the smallest town in the world at Hum, the Butoniga lake, and Buzet's old walls, closing at a family winery.

  6. Day 6

    The Adriatic again

    A second private boat day, this time the Rovinj archipelago and Lim Bay — a different stretch of coast, the same unhurried logic, with a sunset run back to the mainland if conditions allow.

  7. Day 7

    Poreč & departure

    A last morning at the Euphrasian Basilica and Poreč's old town before your private transfer to the airport of your choice.

What's included

  • — Private Mercedes V-Class with driver
  • — Premium full-suspension E-MTB across two signature rides
  • — Two private speedboat days — Brijuni and the Rovinj archipelago
  • — Karlić truffle hunting and three winery experiences
  • — Two-base premium stays, coast and inland
  • — End-to-end logistics and on-trip concierge
  • — All meals throughout the journey
  • — A detailed day-by-day itinerary, provided on request

Questions

+ Is the Istria Signature Journey private?

Yes — every Adrion journey runs exclusively for your party, arranged around your dates and pace.

+ Is previous cycling experience required?

No — the E-MTB days suit a general level of fitness, with vehicle support and flexible route planning throughout.

+ Why two accommodation bases instead of one?

It reduces daily travel and lets you experience both the western coastline and inland Istria properly, rather than rushing between them.

+ Can this journey be extended?

Yes — it combines naturally with a Kvarner extension or another Adrion journey.

    Arrival in the Plitvice Region

  2. Day 2

  3. Day 3

    Northern Velebit E-MTB

    The first Premium E-MTB experience explores the mountain, forest and karst landscapes of Northern Velebit, combined with an Adrion Mountain Picnic and, according to daily routing, the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Krasno.

  4. Day 4

    Velebit Channel, Pag & Boškinac

    Travel from the mountains to the coast before departing by private boat towards Pag for swimming, snorkeling and a Signature gastronomic experience at Boškinac.

  5. Day 5

    Senj & the Journey to Gorski Kotar

    Descend towards Senj for a selected historic and coastal experience before travelling into the forests and lakes of Gorski Kotar.

  6. Day 6

    Lokvarsko Lake, Golubinjak & Deep Forest E-MTB

    Ride through the lake and forest landscapes surrounding Lokve and Golubinjak, with an Adrion Forest Picnic incorporated into the day.

  7. Day 7

    Risnjak National Park E-MTB

    Explore the protected mountain forests and wilderness landscapes of Risnjak National Park during the third dedicated cycling experience.

  8. Day 8

    From the Forests to Krk · Vrbnik E-MTB & Wine

    Cross to Krk for a Mediterranean E-MTB experience through vineyards, stone landscapes and Adriatic viewpoints, followed by a carefully selected Vrbnik wine experience.

  9. Day 9

    Private Kvarner Island Experience

    Depart privately from Krk for a full day among the islands, coastlines and secluded bays of Kvarner, with swimming, snorkeling and a carefully selected lunch before returning for a Signature farewell dinner.

  10. Day 10

    Krk & Departure

    Enjoy an unhurried final morning by the Adriatic, with time for swimming or Krk Old Town depending on departure timing, followed by a farewell lunch and private departure transfer.

    Krka & Šibenik Signature Experience

    Krka National Park and its waterfalls, the boat transfer down to Skradin, and the UNESCO-listed Cathedral of St James in Šibenik.

  4. Day 4

    Northern Dalmatia Discovery

    Northern Dalmatia at its quietest — Nin and the Church of the Holy Cross, the salt pans, and the wineries and olive groves of Ravni Kotari.

  5. Day 5

    Embarkation · Kornati National Park

    Embarkation and the safety briefing, then out into Kornati National Park as the journey moves from the mainland to the sea.

  6. Day 6

    Šibenik Archipelago

    A morning cruise through the Šibenik archipelago to Prvić and Zlarin, islands where the pace has not changed in generations.

  7. Day 7

    Šolta · Hvar

    Cruising to Šolta with a swimming stop, then on to Hvar for the evening.

  8. Day 8

    Pakleni Islands · Vis

    The Pakleni Islands and their channels for swimming, then across to Vis — an island closed to visitors for decades and all the better preserved for it.

  9. Day 9

    Biševo · Brač · Split

    Biševo and the Blue Cave subject to sea conditions, then Brač before returning to Split.

  10. Day 10

    Split & Trogir UNESCO Experience

    The UNESCO day: Salona Archaeological Park, Diocletian’s Palace in Split and the old town of Trogir.

  11. Day 11

    Cetina Signature Experience

    The Cetina Signature Experience, adapted individually to the group — the canyon, the river and the landscape above Omiš.

  12. Day 12

    Biokovo Signature Experience

    Biokovo Nature Park, the Skywalk and the mountain road high above the Makarska Riviera.

  13. Day 13

    Makarska Riviera & Brač Signature Speedboat Experience

    A signature speedboat day along the Makarska Riviera and across to Brač, with swimming and a final lunch by the sea.

  14. Day 14

    Departure

    A relaxed final morning before the private departure transfer.

Central Dalmatia · Ten days, four of them cruising

Central Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea

From €8,290 per person

Central Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea has been created for travellers seeking the complete character of the region through one carefully curated private journey. Rather than focusing on a single destination or style of travel, it combines three defining dimensions: the archaeological and cultural foundations of ancient Dalmatia, a four-day private Adriatic cruise through its most celebrated islands, and a conclusion high above the coastline within Biokovo Nature Park before descending to the Makarska Riviera.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Ancient Dalmatia

    Your journey begins where the story of Dalmatia itself first unfolded. Following your arrival, you are welcomed by your Adrion Travel Host before travelling to Salona, once the capital of the Roman province of Dalmatia. Although today peaceful and surrounded by nature, Salona was once among the most influential cities of the Adriatic world. Accompanied by professional archaeological interpretation, the ancient streets, amphitheatre, basilicas and city walls reveal the remarkable history that shaped the region for centuries. Rather than treating Salona as an isolated archaeological site, the experience continues naturally into Split, where the story of the Roman Empire remains alive inside Diocletian's Palace. Walking through its streets, squares and hidden passages reveals how one imperial residence gradually evolved into one of the Mediterranean's most vibrant historic cities. As evening approaches, the atmosphere changes from historical discovery to relaxed Dalmatian hospitality. A carefully selected welcome dinner introduces regional cuisine and local wines while guests settle into the comfortable rhythm that will define the days ahead. The first day establishes the cultural foundations of the journey, providing the historical context for everything that follows.

  2. Day 2

    Trogir & Central Dalmatian Wine

    Today's experience continues the cultural journey through another of Dalmatia's most remarkable historic towns. Situated on a small island connected by stone bridges, Trogir preserves more than two thousand years of architectural history within one of the Adriatic's finest medieval urban centres. Its narrow streets, elegant palaces, Romanesque cathedral and lively waterfront create an atmosphere distinctly different from Split while remaining deeply connected to the same maritime traditions. Rather than rushing between monuments, the experience unfolds at a relaxed pace, allowing time to appreciate the town's remarkable character, browse local artisan shops and enjoy the everyday rhythm of life within a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Following a carefully curated lunch, the afternoon moves inland towards one of Central Dalmatia's selected wineries. Here, guests discover indigenous grape varieties, regional winemaking traditions and carefully selected wines that reflect the unique climate and limestone landscapes of Dalmatia. Conversations with local producers provide valuable insight into generations of craftsmanship that continue to shape the region's gastronomic identity. Returning to Split in the early evening, guests enjoy free time before preparing for the transition from land to sea.

  3. Day 3

    The Cetina Signature Experience

    Leaving the historic coastline behind, today's journey explores one of Croatia's most spectacular natural landscapes. The emerald waters of the Cetina River have carved an extraordinary canyon through the Dalmatian hinterland, creating an environment that contrasts beautifully with the coastal scenery experienced during the previous days. Every Cetina Signature Experience is individually adapted according to guest preferences. Those seeking adventure may choose professionally guided rafting or canyoning, while others may prefer scenic viewpoints, hiking or a slower exploration of the canyon and surrounding villages. Regardless of the chosen format, the objective remains the same: to experience the exceptional beauty of the Cetina while maintaining the balanced pace that characterises every Adrion Signature Journey. A traditional Dalmatian lunch follows the morning activities before the journey continues to Omiš, where the Cetina meets the Adriatic beneath dramatic limestone cliffs. Once home to legendary pirates, Omiš today combines maritime history, spectacular scenery and authentic Mediterranean charm. Returning to the Split region, the evening offers an opportunity to relax before embarking on the maritime chapter of the journey the following morning.

  4. Day 4

    Embarkation • The Adriatic Begins

    After breakfast, the journey enters an entirely new chapter. Guests transfer to the selected marina where a carefully chosen private yacht, premium catamaran or traditional gulet awaits. Following a warm welcome by the captain and crew, luggage is settled onboard, safety procedures are introduced and preparations begin for four unforgettable days at sea. As the vessel leaves the mainland behind, the pace of the journey changes almost immediately. Busy streets and historic cities give way to open horizons, quiet bays and the gentle rhythm of the Adriatic. Cruising towards Hvar, guests experience the unique freedom that only private navigation can provide. Depending on weather conditions and departure time, the afternoon may include a refreshing swim in a secluded bay before continuing towards one of Croatia's most celebrated island destinations. Upon arrival, Hvar reveals a harmonious blend of Venetian elegance, historic architecture, lively cafés and Mediterranean atmosphere. Guests may explore the waterfront promenade, historic squares and narrow stone streets before enjoying dinner aboard the vessel or at one of Adrion's carefully selected island restaurants. As the sun sets over the harbour, the first evening onboard introduces a completely different way of experiencing Dalmatia—where the sea itself becomes both the route and the destination.

  5. Day 5

    Pakleni Islands & Southern Hvar

    With no fixed ferry schedules or crowded excursion timetables to follow, the day unfolds according to the natural rhythm of the Adriatic. The spectacular Pakleni Islands form a maze of pine-covered islets, hidden coves and crystal-clear lagoons best explored by private vessel. Throughout the day, guests enjoy leisurely cruising, swimming in secluded bays and moments of complete tranquillity away from the busiest sailing routes. Rather than focusing on covering distance, today celebrates the simple pleasures of life at sea. Time slows naturally as anchorages, quiet beaches and panoramic island scenery invite guests to experience the Adriatic at a far more personal pace. Depending on the final itinerary and guest preferences, the afternoon may also include a carefully selected winery experience introducing Hvar's long-standing wine traditions and indigenous grape varieties. As evening approaches, another carefully curated island dinner concludes a day dedicated to relaxation, authentic gastronomy and the timeless beauty of the Dalmatian archipelago. The following morning, the journey continues towards one of Croatia's most distinctive island landscapes—Vis.

  6. Day 6

    Vis • Komiža • Biševo

    The sixth day explores one of the Adriatic's most authentic island destinations. For decades, Vis remained closed to international tourism due to its strategic military importance. Today, that history has helped preserve an island whose atmosphere feels noticeably different from many other destinations along the Croatian coast. Traditional fishing communities, quiet harbours, dramatic cliffs and crystal-clear waters create an experience defined by authenticity rather than crowds. The day often begins with a leisurely cruise towards Biševo, where weather and sea conditions may allow a visit to the world-famous Blue Cave. When conditions are favourable, the extraordinary natural light inside the cave creates one of the Adriatic's most memorable spectacles. Depending on navigation and guest preferences, the route may also include the Green Cave, Stiniva Cove or secluded swimming locations selected by the captain. Later, the vessel arrives in Komiža, a charming fishing town where life continues at a slower Mediterranean rhythm. Time ashore allows guests to wander through narrow stone streets, enjoy the harbour atmosphere and experience the traditions that have shaped island life for generations. Throughout the day, flexibility remains one of the greatest advantages of private cruising. Rather than following a rigid timetable, the captain continuously adapts the route according to weather conditions, sea state and guest preferences, ensuring every departure offers the best possible experience. A carefully selected island dinner concludes another unforgettable day on the Adriatic before spending the night aboard in one of the region's peaceful harbours or anchorages.

  7. Day 7

    Return Across the Adriatic

    The final day at sea offers an opportunity to simply enjoy the journey itself. Morning light reflects across the Adriatic as the vessel gradually begins its return towards the mainland. Depending on weather conditions and the vessel's position, the route may include one final swimming stop, a secluded anchorage or relaxed cruising past islands that have defined Central Dalmatia's maritime identity for centuries. Without rushing between destinations, guests have time to appreciate the quiet rhythm of life aboard, enjoying one final lunch surrounded by open sea before returning to the marina. Following disembarkation, the journey takes one of its most remarkable turns. Leaving the coastline behind, the route climbs into Biokovo Nature Park, where winding mountain roads gradually reveal increasingly spectacular panoramic views across the Adriatic. Only a few hours after cruising between the islands, guests now find themselves looking down upon the very landscapes they explored from the sea. By late afternoon, arrival at the newly renovated Vošac Mountain Lodge marks the beginning of the journey's final chapter. Here, mountain tranquillity replaces the rhythm of the sea, while panoramic terraces offer uninterrupted views stretching across the Makarska Riviera, Brač, Hvar, Vis and beyond. As sunset colours the Adriatic below, guests enjoy regional mountain cuisine and an atmosphere unlike anywhere else in the itinerary.

  8. Day 8

    The Biokovo Signature Experience

    The morning begins in complete tranquillity. High above the coastline, Vošac Mountain Lodge offers one of Croatia's most spectacular panoramic settings. Surrounded by the landscapes of Biokovo Nature Park, guests experience an entirely different side of Dalmatia—one defined by fresh mountain air, silence and extraordinary views extending across the Adriatic. Following breakfast, the experience may include scenic viewpoints, short panoramic walks and interpretation of Biokovo's unique natural environment. Rather than rushing through the park, the programme allows guests to appreciate the peaceful atmosphere that makes this part of Croatia so distinctive. The journey then gradually descends towards the coast. As the road winds through Biokovo, mountain scenery slowly gives way to olive groves, vineyards and finally the turquoise waters of the Makarska Riviera. This transition from summit to sea provides one of the most striking visual contrasts of the entire itinerary. The afternoon is intentionally relaxed, allowing time to discover Makarska's waterfront, historic centre or simply enjoy the slower Mediterranean rhythm before checking into the final accommodation.

  9. Day 9

    The Makarska Riviera

    The final full day celebrates one of Croatia's most beautiful stretches of coastline. Rather than attempting to visit every town along the Riviera, the itinerary follows a carefully curated route that reflects the season, accommodation location and guest preferences. Elegant seaside towns such as Brela, Baška Voda, Tučepi and Podgora each reveal a different character, while hidden viewpoints and quieter coastal areas offer a more authentic perspective of the region. Throughout the day, there is time to enjoy local producers, carefully selected restaurants and the relaxed atmosphere that defines life along the Adriatic. Optional experiences such as hiking, cycling, kayaking or a private boat excursion may also be incorporated according to individual interests. As evening approaches, a carefully curated Farewell Dinner overlooking the Adriatic provides a memorable conclusion to ten days of discovery. From Roman heritage and UNESCO towns to island life, mountain landscapes and authentic Dalmatian hospitality, every chapter of the journey comes together in one final celebration of Central Dalmatia.

  10. Day 10

    Departure

    Following breakfast, private transfers are arranged according to each guest's onward travel plans. Although the journey reaches its conclusion, the experiences shared across ten carefully balanced days leave a lasting understanding of Central Dalmatia—not simply through the destinations visited, but through the connections between its history, islands, mountains, gastronomy and people. A Journey Across Three Worlds Central Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea has been designed to reveal the region through three defining landscapes. The journey begins among the archaeological treasures and historic towns that shaped Dalmatia's past before naturally transitioning onto the Adriatic through a four-day private cruise across its islands. The final chapter rises into the dramatic landscapes of Biokovo before returning once more to the coastline of the Makarska Riviera. Every transition has been carefully considered. History leads naturally to the sea, the sea gives way to the mountains, and the mountains return once more to the Adriatic, creating a journey that feels seamless from beginning to end. Rather than combining independent excursions, this itinerary has been curated as one complete experience. Ancient heritage, private cruising, authentic gastronomy, spectacular natural landscapes and personalised service combine to reveal the remarkable diversity of Central Dalmatia through a rhythm that is both immersive and unforgettable.

Northern Dalmatia · Ten days, four of them at sea

Northern Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea

From €7,990 per person

Northern Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea has been created for travellers who wish to experience the region completely — from its Roman cities and protected inland landscapes to the archipelago that defines it. The journey begins on land in Zadar, Krka and Ravni Kotari before embarking for several days aboard a private vessel through Kornati and the Šibenik archipelago, then returns to the mainland for the Zrmanja canyon and the distinctive island of Pag.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Arrival · Discovering Zadar

    Private arrival transfer to Zadar and a walking experience through the Roman Forum, St Donatus, the Cathedral of St Anastasia and Kalelarga, ending at the Sea Organ and the Greeting to the Sun for the sunset. A carefully selected welcome dinner introduces the flavours of Northern Dalmatia.

  2. Day 2

    Krka National Park · Skradin · Šibenik

    A morning in Krka National Park with its waterfalls and walking trails, the boat transfer down to Skradin and a traditional Dalmatian lunch, before continuing to Šibenik for the UNESCO-listed Cathedral of St James and the medieval old town.

  3. Day 3

    Nin · Ravni Kotari · the flavours of Northern Dalmatia

    The Church of the Holy Cross at Nin and the salt pans, then inland to Ravni Kotari for a curated winery experience and a premium olive oil tasting among the vineyards and olive groves that supply the region.

  4. Day 4

    Embarkation · the Adriatic begins

    Embarkation aboard your selected vessel and the safety briefing, then the first afternoon at sea as the journey turns away from the mainland and settles into the rhythm of the archipelago.

  5. Day 5

    Through the Kornati Archipelago

    The fifth day is dedicated to one of Croatia's most extraordinary natural wonders. Cruising through Kornati National Park, guests discover an archipelago shaped by stone, sea and centuries of maritime tradition. Unlike the dramatic cliffs of Telašćica explored the previous day, Kornati reveal a landscape of remarkable simplicity, where countless islands, crystal-clear waters and quiet anchorages create an atmosphere unlike anywhere else on the Adriatic. The day unfolds at a relaxed pace. Time is reserved for scenic cruising, swimming in secluded bays and exploring islands that remain largely untouched by modern development. A carefully curated lunch highlights fresh local ingredients while allowing guests to experience the authentic rhythm of island life. As the afternoon progresses, the journey continues through one of the Mediterranean's most remarkable island landscapes before concluding with another Adrion Curated Island Dinner in a traditional konoba. The evening is spent at anchor near Žut Island, where the tranquillity of the Adriatic becomes part of the experience itself.

  6. Day 6

    Island Life Experience

    Beyond spectacular scenery lies another defining characteristic of Northern Dalmatia—its island communities. Today's cruise explores the quieter side of the archipelago, where life continues at a slower pace and centuries-old traditions remain closely connected to the sea. Depending on weather conditions and navigational recommendations, the route may include Murter, Betina, Kaprije or Zlarin, with every departure adapted to create the most rewarding experience. Guests have time to stroll through peaceful harbours, discover traditional villages, observe local craftsmanship or simply enjoy the atmosphere of authentic island life. Swimming in secluded bays, relaxed cruising and another carefully selected Adrion Curated Island Konoba complete a day focused less on sightseeing and more on experiencing the Adriatic as locals have known it for generations. As the sun sets over the islands, the final evening aboard offers an opportunity to appreciate the unique perspective that only life at sea can provide.

  7. Day 7

    Returning to the Mainland

    The final morning aboard begins at an unhurried pace. Breakfast is enjoyed while cruising through the Northern Dalmatian Archipelago, with one final opportunity to swim in the clear Adriatic before returning towards the mainland. Following lunch onboard, guests disembark and are welcomed back by their Adrion Travel Host, who continues the land programme for the remainder of the journey. Returning to land does not mark the end of the experience, but the beginning of its final chapter, where Northern Dalmatia reveals yet another side of its remarkable diversity.

  8. Day 8

    Zrmanja Signature Experience

    Today's programme introduces one of Croatia's most spectacular river landscapes through the included Zrmanja Signature Experience. Guests may choose between two carefully curated ways of discovering the dramatic beauty of the Zrmanja Canyon. Those seeking a more active experience may join a professionally guided rafting adventure, navigating crystal-clear waters beneath towering limestone cliffs before enjoying a traditional riverside lunch. Alternatively, guests preferring a slower pace may choose a scenic exploration of the Zrmanja region, discovering panoramic viewpoints, authentic rural landscapes and regional gastronomy while experiencing one of Northern Dalmatia's most striking natural environments. Although the pace differs, both experiences reveal the extraordinary diversity that defines the inland landscapes of Northern Dalmatia.

  9. Day 9

    The Flavours of Pag

    The final full day is dedicated to one of Croatia's most distinctive islands. Crossing the iconic Pag Bridge, guests arrive in a landscape unlike any other along the Adriatic coast, where stone, sea and centuries of tradition have created one of Croatia's most recognisable cultural landscapes. The journey explores the historic town of Pag before continuing to the ancient olive groves of Lun, home to some of the oldest living olive trees in the Mediterranean. Guests also discover the traditions behind the island's world-renowned Pag Cheese Experience, gaining insight into one of Croatia's most celebrated regional products before continuing towards Boškinac. The journey concludes with the Boškinac Gastronomic Experience, where contemporary Croatian cuisine and exceptional local ingredients provide a fitting culinary finale to ten carefully curated days across Northern Dalmatia. Returning to Zadar, the evening offers time to reflect on a journey that has gradually revealed the region through its landscapes, flavours, islands and people.

  10. Day 10

    Until Next Time

    Following breakfast, a private transfer takes guests to Zadar Airport or their preferred onward destination. Although the itinerary comes to an end, Northern Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea has been designed to leave far more than lasting photographs. Through carefully curated experiences on land and at sea, meaningful encounters with local people and a thoughtful balance of nature, gastronomy and culture, the journey offers a genuine connection with one of Croatia's most captivating coastal regions. A Journey Between Land & Sea Northern Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea has been created around a simple philosophy: the most memorable journeys reveal a destination from every perspective. Historic cities introduce its past. National parks reveal its extraordinary natural beauty. Vineyards, olive groves and local producers preserve generations of culinary tradition. A private Adriatic cruise uncovers secluded islands, hidden bays and the maritime character that has shaped Northern Dalmatia for centuries. Rather than presenting these experiences individually, the journey connects them into one seamless story where every day has its own identity while contributing to a carefully balanced whole. The result is not simply a combination of exceptional destinations, but a private journey that reflects Adrion's commitment to authenticity, thoughtful planning and meaningful travel—revealing Northern Dalmatia through its landscapes, gastronomy, island communities and the Adriatic itself.

Central Dalmatia · Five days between the islands and the Cetina

Central Dalmatia Essentials

From €3,690 per person

Central Dalmatia Essentials introduces the region through the experiences that define it. Roman foundations and a living UNESCO palace, an island whose stone built cathedrals across Europe, a river canyon that cuts down to the sea, and the Adriatic light of Hvar and the Pakleni Islands — each day turns to a different side of the region, with enough time to appreciate every destination without unnecessary rushing.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Ancient Dalmatia

    Your journey begins where the foundations of Dalmatia were laid. The first experience takes you to Salona, once the capital of the Roman province of Dalmatia and the political, cultural and commercial centre of the region for centuries. Accompanied by professional archaeological interpretation, the remains of temples, city walls, early Christian basilicas and public buildings reveal the story of one of the most influential Roman cities on the eastern Adriatic. From Salona, the journey naturally continues to Diocletian's Palace in Split. Rather than presenting these as two separate visits, the experience connects them into one historical narrative, explaining how the decline of Salona and the construction of the Emperor's Palace shaped the birth of modern Split. Walking through Peristyle, the Cathedral of Saint Domnius, the Vestibule and the ancient streets that still form the living heart of the city, guests experience history not as a collection of monuments, but as a city that has evolved continuously for more than seventeen centuries. The evening concludes with a carefully curated welcome dinner introducing the flavours, wines and hospitality of Central Dalmatia while setting the tone for the days ahead.

  2. Day 2

    Brač — Stone, Tradition & the Adriatic

    Today's journey leaves the mainland behind to explore the largest island of Central Dalmatia aboard a private speedboat. Brač has long been recognised for its remarkable white limestone, traditional craftsmanship and authentic island communities. Its stone has shaped some of the region's most significant buildings for centuries, becoming one of the island's defining symbols. Arriving in Pučišća, guests discover one of Croatia's most distinctive coastal settlements, internationally recognised for its stonemasonry tradition and timeless Mediterranean character. As the day unfolds, scenic cruising reveals secluded bays, crystal-clear waters and quiet stretches of coastline that contrast beautifully with the historic experiences of the previous day. A traditional island lunch showcases fresh local ingredients and regional recipes before the afternoon offers time to relax and enjoy the Adriatic at a slower pace. Depending on weather conditions and navigation, additional coastal locations may be included where they enhance the overall experience. Brač introduces a quieter, more authentic rhythm of island life, where craftsmanship, tradition and natural beauty exist in perfect balance.

  3. Day 3

    The Cetina Signature Experience

    Leaving the coastline behind, today's journey explores one of Central Dalmatia's most remarkable natural landscapes. The Cetina River has shaped dramatic canyons, emerald pools and fertile valleys that present a completely different side of Dalmatia from the islands and coastal towns experienced earlier in the journey. Recognising that every traveller enjoys nature differently, the experience is individually adapted according to each group's preferred level of activity. Whether seeking adventure on the river or a slower exploration of the surrounding landscapes, every departure maintains the same carefully balanced rhythm while allowing guests to experience the extraordinary beauty of the Cetina region in a way that best suits their travel style. A traditional Dalmatian lunch introduces the flavours of the hinterland before the afternoon continues in Omiš, a town where the Cetina River meets the Adriatic Sea. Once home to the famous Omiš pirates, the town today combines medieval streets, dramatic cliffs and a spectacular coastal setting, offering a fitting conclusion to a day defined by nature, history and local traditions.

  4. Day 4

    Hvar & the Pakleni Islands

    The second day on the Adriatic reveals a different expression of island life. While Brač is defined by craftsmanship and tradition, Hvar is celebrated for its elegant historic town, maritime heritage, Mediterranean atmosphere and long-standing wine culture. Arriving by private speedboat, guests have time to explore the historic streets, lively waterfront and architectural heritage that have made Hvar one of Croatia's most recognisable island destinations. The journey then continues towards the Pakleni Islands, an archipelago of secluded coves, pine-covered islets and crystal-clear waters best experienced from the sea. Here, the pace slows once again, allowing time to swim, relax and enjoy the quieter side of the Adriatic. A carefully curated lunch and a premium wine experience further introduce the flavours of Hvar, where generations of winemakers have shaped one of Croatia's most respected wine-producing islands. As the return journey follows the Dalmatian coastline back towards Split, the final island experience brings together culture, gastronomy and the sea in one memorable conclusion.

  5. Day 5

    Trogir & Farewell

    The journey concludes in Trogir, one of the Adriatic's finest preserved medieval towns and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Unlike the larger cities visited earlier in the itinerary, Trogir offers a more intimate atmosphere, where narrow stone streets, elegant squares and a relaxed waterfront invite guests to slow down and enjoy the final moments of their journey through Central Dalmatia. A carefully selected farewell lunch celebrates the region's culinary traditions one final time before a private transfer brings guests to Split Airport or their onward destination. Although the itinerary comes to an end, the experiences shared over the previous five days leave a deeper understanding of Central Dalmatia—not simply through the places visited, but through the history, landscapes, traditions and people that define the region.

Northern Dalmatia · Five days of cities, islands and national parks

Northern Dalmatia Essentials

From €3,490 per person

Some regions are best understood through a single destination. Northern Dalmatia is not one of them. It is a region shaped by the sea, where ancient cities, protected islands, dramatic cliffs, national parks and authentic gastronomy exist within remarkably short distances of one another. Northern Dalmatia Essentials brings these experiences together in one carefully curated private journey — combining historic cities, island exploration, premium gastronomy and protected natural landscapes in an introduction to the region that is both comprehensive and comfortably paced.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Discovering Zadar

    Your journey begins in Zadar, a city where more than three thousand years of history meet contemporary art and the rhythm of the Adriatic. Following your private arrival transfer, the afternoon is dedicated to exploring the city's historic heart. Roman remains, medieval churches, elegant squares and lively stone streets gradually lead towards the famous waterfront, where the Sea Organ and the Greeting to the Sun have become modern symbols of Dalmatia. As daylight fades, Zadar reveals one of its greatest traditions—the sunset over the Adriatic. The evening continues with a carefully selected welcome dinner introducing the authentic flavours and wines of Northern Dalmatia while setting the pace for the days ahead.

  2. Day 2

    Dugi Otok & Telašćica Nature Park

    Leaving the mainland behind, today's journey begins aboard a private speedboat heading towards one of Croatia's most spectacular island landscapes. The destination is Telašćica Nature Park, a protected bay famous for its dramatic limestone cliffs, peaceful coves and the remarkable Lake Mir. A leisurely walk through the park leads to breathtaking viewpoints before reaching the warm saltwater lake, where guests may enjoy an optional swim or simply relax within one of the Adriatic's most unique natural settings. Lunch is served in a traditional island konoba, celebrating fresh seafood, regional produce and the relaxed pace of island life. During the afternoon, the journey continues through hidden bays and along the spectacular coastline of Dugi Otok. Depending on sea conditions, the route may also include Sakarun Beach or the iconic Veli Rat Lighthouse before returning to the mainland. This day captures the essence of island Dalmatia—quiet, authentic and deeply connected to the sea.

  3. Day 3

    Waterfalls, Wine & UNESCO Heritage

    Today's journey moves inland towards Krka National Park, where emerald waters, waterfalls and shaded walking trails reveal one of Croatia's most celebrated natural landscapes. Following a boat ride into the picturesque town of Skradin, guests enjoy a relaxed lunch before continuing towards Šibenik, one of the Adriatic's finest historic cities. The afternoon explores narrow stone streets, lively squares and the magnificent Cathedral of St. James, recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and considered one of the most important Renaissance monuments in Croatia. The day concludes with a signature dinner showcasing the creativity, traditions and seasonal flavours of Dalmatian cuisine in one of the region's finest restaurants.

  4. Day 4

    The Kornati Archipelago

    The second private boating experience explores an entirely different side of Northern Dalmatia. The Kornati National Park is a remarkable collection of islands shaped by wind, stone and the sea over thousands of years. Unlike the lush landscapes of Dugi Otok, Kornati offer an almost otherworldly scenery defined by dramatic rock formations, crystal-clear waters and timeless island settlements. Cruising between the islands, stopping in peaceful coves and enjoying lunch in a traditional island konoba creates a slower rhythm that perfectly reflects the simplicity and beauty of life in the archipelago. This is a day dedicated to the Adriatic in its purest form.

  5. Day 5

    The Flavours of Ravni Kotari

    The final day turns inland once more, revealing a very different landscape shaped by vineyards, olive groves and traditional agriculture. Depending on departure time, the journey may include the historic royal town of Nin, followed by a visit to Korlat Winery, where guests discover some of Croatia's finest wines through a guided tasting. The experience continues with a premium olive oil tasting before a farewell lunch celebrating the culinary traditions of Northern Dalmatia. It is a fitting conclusion to a journey that has gradually revealed the region through its landscapes, flavours, history and people.

Dalmatia · Five active days from the river to the islands

Adventure Dalmatia Journey — 5 Days

From €2,690 per person

The five-day Adventure Dalmatia Journey extends the Cetina programme into the mountains and out to sea. It follows the river from canyon to coast, climbs into Biokovo Nature Park high above the Makarska Riviera, and finishes among the Adriatic islands — five private days that move continuously between water, mountain and stone, with professional guiding and carefully selected gastronomy throughout.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    The Spirit of Cetina

    Your adventure begins where the mountains meet the river. After a scenic drive from Split, you arrive in the spectacular Cetina Canyon, where crystal-clear waters flow beneath towering limestone cliffs that have shaped this landscape for thousands of years. Following a professional safety briefing, the journey continues downstream through one of Croatia's most beautiful river canyons. Gentle rapids, tranquil stretches of emerald water and opportunities to swim create an experience that is exciting without feeling rushed. The day concludes with a carefully curated riverside lunch, introducing the first flavours of authentic Dalmatian cuisine before returning comfortably to Split.

  2. Day 2

    Vruja Hidden Coast Experience

    The second day reveals one of Dalmatia's most extraordinary hidden landscapes. Equipped with premium full-suspension electric mountain bikes, you follow carefully selected panoramic coastal roads where dramatic mountain scenery meets uninterrupted views across the Adriatic. Quiet villages, hidden viewpoints and winding mountain routes reveal a side of Dalmatia rarely experienced beyond the main tourist routes. Reaching the cliffs above Vruja, the journey changes pace. Leaving the bicycles behind, a hidden trail descends towards one of Dalmatia's most secluded coastal landscapes. Towering limestone cliffs surround crystal-clear Adriatic waters, creating a remarkable natural setting that remains largely untouched by mass tourism. Here, time slows down. Enjoy swimming in the clear sea, relax beneath the surrounding cliffs or simply absorb the silence and beauty of this unique location before gathering for the exclusive Adrion Signature Picnic, carefully prepared with premium regional products and served overlooking one of the Adriatic's most spectacular coastal settings. As the afternoon light transforms the landscape, the scenic return ride offers an entirely new perspective before returning comfortably to Split.

  3. Day 3

    Cetina Valley Premium E-MTB Experience

    The journey moves inland once again, this time exploring the quieter landscapes surrounding the Cetina Valley. Premium electric mountain bikes make it possible to comfortably explore scenic gravel roads, forest tracks and traditional villages while enjoying uninterrupted views across the valley and surrounding mountains. Unlike the previous day's coastal adventure, today's experience focuses on the peaceful rhythm of Dalmatia's rural landscapes. Throughout the ride, regular stops provide opportunities for photography, local insight and simply appreciating the silence of the countryside. A traditional hinterland lunch completes the experience before a relaxed return to Split.

  4. Day 4

    Biokovo Mountain Experience

    Today's journey climbs into the dramatic landscapes of Biokovo Nature Park, where rugged mountain scenery rises high above the Adriatic coastline. The experience follows carefully selected panoramic roads through one of Croatia's most impressive mountain environments before reaching the famous Biokovo Skywalk, where breathtaking views extend across the Makarska Riviera, nearby islands and the open Adriatic. Beyond the Skywalk, the day continues through lesser-known viewpoints and scenic locations that reveal another side of Biokovo rarely experienced by ordinary visitors. Lunch is served at a traditional mountain restaurant, introducing regional recipes and locally sourced ingredients that reflect the character of Dalmatia's highlands. The return journey follows the spectacular Makarska Riviera, offering one final perspective of the mountains before returning to Split.

  5. Day 5

    Adriatic Islands Adventure

    The final chapter of the journey belongs to the sea. Board your private speedboat and cruise through the crystal-clear waters of the Central Dalmatian archipelago, discovering secluded bays, hidden beaches and picturesque island landscapes accessible only from the sea. Enjoy swimming and snorkelling in pristine waters before experiencing parasailing, where the Adriatic reveals itself from an entirely new perspective high above the coastline. Later, a carefully curated seaside lunch celebrates the final day with fresh Mediterranean flavours served at one of Adrion's selected waterfront restaurants. The afternoon unfolds at a relaxed pace with additional opportunities to swim, unwind and enjoy the beauty of the islands before returning to Split. A Journey to Remember The Adventure Dalmatia Journey has been designed to reveal Dalmatia through movement rather than observation. Every day introduces a completely different landscape, allowing rivers, mountains, hidden coastlines and islands to gradually become part of one connected story. From the emerald waters of the Cetina River and the dramatic limestone canyons to panoramic mountain landscapes, the hidden coastline of Vruja and the crystal-clear Adriatic islands, every experience has been carefully selected to showcase the remarkable diversity of Dalmatia. More than a collection of outdoor activities, this is a carefully curated private journey where adventure, comfort, authentic gastronomy and exceptional natural beauty come together to create memories that remain long after the journey has ended. Five carefully curated days. Five extraordinary landscapes. One unforgettable journey through the wild side of Dalmatia.

Southern Dalmatia · Three days where history meets the Adriatic

Classic Dubrovnik Journey

From €1,590 per person

Some destinations are admired for their beauty. Others are remembered for their history. Dubrovnik is exceptional because it offers both. For centuries the Republic of Ragusa stood among the most influential maritime republics of the Mediterranean, and that legacy of diplomacy, trade and architecture still defines the city. The Classic Dubrovnik Journey is for travellers who wish to experience Dubrovnik beyond its famous landmarks — revealing its character through local tradition, authentic gastronomy and the timeless relationship between the Adriatic and the stone walls that have protected it for centuries.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Welcome to Dubrovnik

    A private welcome at the airport, marina or your chosen arrival point, and a transfer by luxury Mercedes-Benz to your accommodation, where the rest of the afternoon is intentionally left unhurried. As evening approaches a leisurely orientation walk introduces the city’s elegant streets and public squares, before a carefully curated welcome dinner. This first evening is built not around sightseeing but around settling into the rhythm of Dubrovnik.

  2. Day 2

    The story of Dubrovnik

    With your licensed local guide, the day begins at Fort Lovrijenac, whose stone fortifications overlook the Adriatic and the city walls, then continues into the UNESCO World Heritage Old Town. Rather than a conventional sightseeing route, the experience takes in artisan workshops, traditional Dubrovnik jewellery, historic markets and quiet corners that reveal the city beyond its monuments — with a relaxed stop for coffee, regional wine or local delicacies. Later the journey climbs to Mount Srđ for panoramic views across the walls, Lokrum, the Elafiti archipelago and the open sea, and the day closes with a curated gastronomic experience.

  3. Day 3

    The Elafiti Islands

    The final day reveals the maritime soul of Dubrovnik. Boarding your private speedboat, you cruise to Koločep, where secluded bays and — weather permitting — the Blue Cave invite swimming and snorkelling. The journey continues to Lopud, its elegant waterfront and the sandy beach at Šunj, followed by a curated waterfront lunch. The afternoon is spent on Šipan, largest of the Elafiti, among quiet harbours and historic stone architecture, before the cruise back towards Dubrovnik and one final view of the walls rising from the sea.

  • — Luxury Mercedes-Benz transportation with private airport, hotel or marina transfers

Classic South Dalmatia Journey

Southern Dalmatia is one of Croatia’s most diverse regions, where medieval cities, protected national parks, secluded islands and celebrated wine landscapes sit within a remarkably compact area. The Classic South Dalmatia Journey reveals that diversity through a carefully balanced private experience — from the timeless streets of Dubrovnik and the peaceful lakes of Mljet to the tranquil Elafiti and the renowned vineyards of Pelješac. A single accommodation base means the journey unfolds at a comfortable pace, without changing hotels.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Welcome to Dubrovnik

    A private welcome at Dubrovnik Airport, the marina or your chosen arrival point, and a transfer by luxury Mercedes-Benz to your accommodation, where the afternoon is left at leisure. As evening approaches, a relaxed orientation introduces the city before a carefully curated welcome dinner celebrating the flavours and hospitality that have welcomed travellers to Southern Dalmatia for centuries.

  2. Day 2

    Dubrovnik — the legacy of the Republic of Ragusa

    With your licensed local guide the day begins at Fort Lovrijenac, whose imposing walls have protected the city for centuries, then continues into the UNESCO World Heritage Old Town. Walking limestone streets, lively squares and hidden passageways, you discover not only the monuments but the artisan workshops, traditional jewellery, local cafés and markets that define the city today. Later the journey ascends Mount Srđ for panoramic views across Dubrovnik, Lokrum, the Elafiti archipelago and the open Adriatic, closing with a curated gastronomic experience.

  3. Day 3

    Mljet National Park

    Long before reaching Mljet the journey itself becomes the experience. Departing by private speedboat, you cruise across the Adriatic as Dubrovnik’s medieval skyline disappears behind you, passing islands and secluded coves. Surrounded by dense Mediterranean forest and tranquil saltwater lakes, Mljet presents an atmosphere entirely different from the city — Veliko Jezero, Malo Jezero and the island of St Mary, explored on foot, by premium electric bicycle or by kayak. A curated waterfront lunch precedes time to relax and swim before the return cruise.

  4. Day 4

    The Elafiti Islands

    A second day on the water, through the archipelago that has accompanied Dubrovnik’s maritime story for centuries. Koločep, Lopud and Šipan reveal hidden coves, secluded beaches and island communities living at a slower Mediterranean pace, with swimming and snorkelling in bays where the Adriatic is at its clearest. A curated waterfront lunch offers fresh local seafood before the leisurely cruise back, the city walls gradually reappearing on the horizon.

  5. Day 5

    The Pelješac Peninsula

    The final day follows one of Croatia’s most spectacular coastal roads to Pelješac. It begins in Ston, where monumental defensive walls, centuries-old salt pans and internationally renowned oyster farms illustrate the region’s cultural and gastronomic heritage. Panoramic roads then lead to one of the peninsula’s celebrated wineries, where among vineyards overlooking the sea you discover the wines that made Pelješac one of Croatia’s most respected regions, before a curated farewell lunch.

Southern Dalmatia · Ten days, four of them aboard

Southern Dalmatia Signature Land & Sea

From €8,690 per person

Southern Dalmatia is best understood through both its coastline and the Adriatic that has shaped it for centuries — experiencing only the mainland, or only the islands, reveals only part of the story. This flagship journey unites both perspectives into one seamless private experience. Six carefully designed days on land introduce the region through history, local culture and regional gastronomy, while a four-day private cruise lets the Adriatic itself become part of the journey, revealing secluded anchorages, hidden bays and coastal scenery inaccessible by road.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Welcome to Dubrovnik

    A private welcome and transfer by luxury Mercedes-Benz to your carefully selected accommodation, with the afternoon left free after arrival. As evening approaches, a curated welcome dinner introduces the flavours of Southern Dalmatia — the first evening deliberately unhurried, so the rhythm of the region settles before the journey truly begins.

  2. Day 2

    Dubrovnik — the legacy of the Republic of Ragusa

    With your licensed local guide the day opens at Fort Lovrijenac, whose commanding position above the Adriatic has protected the city for centuries, then continues into the UNESCO World Heritage Old Town. Limestone streets, lively squares and hidden passageways reveal architecture, artisan workshops and the everyday life that still shapes the city. The afternoon ascends Mount Srđ for panoramic views across Dubrovnik, Lokrum and the Elafiti archipelago, and the day closes with a curated signature dinner.

  3. Day 3

    The Pelješac Peninsula

    One of Croatia’s most spectacular coastal roads leads to Pelješac. The experience begins in Ston, renowned for its monumental defensive walls, centuries-old salt pans and internationally celebrated oyster tradition, where history and gastronomy meet naturally. Panoramic roads then give way to vineyards and one of the peninsula’s respected wineries, for a curated wine experience among vines overlooking the Adriatic, before a relaxed regional lunch and the return to Dubrovnik.

  4. Day 4

    Embarking on the Adriatic

    A new chapter begins. After a private transfer to Dubrovnik Marina you board your private yacht, premium catamaran or traditional gulet, and the rhythm of the journey changes entirely — roads give way to open water and the historic skyline recedes. Cruising the peaceful Elafiti, you discover secluded bays and hidden anchorages with time for swimming and snorkelling before continuing towards Mljet, and a first night aboard beneath one of the Adriatic’s most spectacular skies.

  5. Day 5

    Mljet National Park

    Morning arrives surrounded by the park’s peaceful landscapes. The day unfolds at an unhurried pace through Veliko Jezero, Malo Jezero and the historic island of St Mary, explored on foot, by premium electric bicycle or by kayak according to interest. Swimming in the calm saltwater lakes, relaxing aboard and a curated waterfront lunch define a day given over to tranquillity and untouched Mediterranean nature.

  6. Day 6

    Korčula — the island of stone and sea

    Approaching Korčula from the sea reveals medieval walls rising above the waterfront, the same first impression generations of sailors have had. With your licensed local guide you explore elegant stone streets, historic squares and beautifully preserved architecture, and the traditions — maritime heritage, local craftsmanship, the long association with Marco Polo — that have shaped the island. A curated wine experience introduces its distinctive indigenous varieties before a leisurely sunset cruise through the surrounding archipelago.

  7. Day 7

    Returning to Dubrovnik

    The final morning aboard begins with breakfast surrounded by the Adriatic. The return voyage keeps a relaxed pace, with time for one last swim in a secluded bay and a curated lunch before passing once more through the tranquil Elafiti. Gradually Dubrovnik’s skyline reappears, marking the end of the maritime chapter, and a private transfer returns you to your hotel after disembarkation.

  8. Day 8

    Konavle

    Having seen Southern Dalmatia from land and sea, the journey turns to the peaceful countryside of Konavle. Traditional villages, the crystal-clear Ljuta River, historic watermills, local olive oil producers and boutique wineries reveal a landscape where agriculture, craftsmanship and family tradition still shape daily life. The afternoon stays intentionally relaxed before the return to Dubrovnik.

  9. Day 9

    Dubrovnik at leisure

    The final full day is deliberately left flexible — returning to favourite places in the Old Town, additional cultural experiences, the city walls, luxury shopping, wellness, a private Adriatic excursion or simply time at your own pace. The journey concludes with a curated farewell dinner celebrating the experiences and memories created throughout Southern Dalmatia.

  10. Day 10

    Until we meet again

    After breakfast, a private transfer to Dubrovnik Airport, the marina or your chosen departure point. The journey ends, though the landscapes, traditions, flavours and Adriatic horizons of Southern Dalmatia tend to stay with travellers long after the return home.

Istria & Kvarner · Ten days, coast to hill town to island

Istria & Kvarner Grand Tour

From €6,890 per person

Istria and Kvarner sit side by side and could not feel less alike — one a peninsula of Venetian coastal towns and hill villages above vineyards, the other a riviera pinned between a mountain and its islands. The Grand Tour takes both in a single ten-day private journey, moving west to east: the Istrian coast, the hill towns of the interior, a private day on the Adriatic, then the crossing into Kvarner for Učka, Rijeka and the island passage south to Lošinj.

The journey

  1. Day 1

    Arrival in Istria

    Your journey begins with a private transfer to your selected accommodation in Rovinj or Bale, the first of three accommodation bases featured throughout the Grand Tour. The first day has been designed to allow time to settle in before the programme begins. Following check-in, you will meet your Adrion Travel Host, who will introduce the journey and provide an overview of the days ahead. The evening concludes with a welcome dinner at a carefully selected regional restaurant, offering an introduction to Istria's culinary traditions.

  2. Day 2

    Western Istria

    The second day is dedicated to the landscapes of western Istria. Using Premium Full-Suspension Electric Mountain Bikes (E-MTBs), guests explore vineyards, olive groves, quiet regional roads and coastal scenery through routes selected according to the itinerary, weather conditions and the group's preferences. The programme combines cycling with regional gastronomy and a boutique winery experience while vehicle support remains available throughout the day.

  3. Day 3

    Central Istria

    The third day introduces another perspective of Istria through its hill towns, local producers and regional heritage. The programme combines Motovun, Grožnjan and carefully selected gastronomic experiences with opportunities to discover boutique wineries, olive oil producers or truffle traditions before returning to the first accommodation base.

  4. Day 4

    Istria Private Adriatic Experience

    The fourth day is dedicated to the Adriatic. A privately organised speedboat experience introduces the western Istrian coastline and the Brijuni archipelago through a carefully planned programme that may include panoramic navigation, authorised stops, swimming opportunities and regional seaside dining. The day concludes with a return to the same accommodation base. The experience has been designed to provide a different perspective of Istria before the journey gradually continues towards Kvarner.

  5. Day 5

    Journey to Kvarner

    The fifth day marks the transition from Istria to Kvarner. Rather than functioning as a standard transfer, the route has been designed as part of the journey itself, combining panoramic drives through eastern Istria and Učka Nature Park with regional gastronomy before arriving on the Opatija Riviera later in the day. The second accommodation base becomes the starting point for exploring mainland Kvarner.

  6. Day 6

    Učka & the Opatija Riviera

    The sixth day combines cycling with the landscapes of Učka Nature Park and the Opatija Riviera. Premium Full-Suspension Electric Mountain Bikes (E-MTBs) provide a comfortable way to experience panoramic viewpoints, forests, coastal roads and historic seaside towns while vehicle support remains available throughout the programme.

  7. Day 7

    Opatija & Rijeka

    The seventh day introduces the cultural heritage of mainland Kvarner. The programme combines Opatija, Volosko, Rijeka and Trsat with carefully selected regional dining, allowing guests to experience another perspective of Croatia's northern Adriatic before continuing towards the islands.

  8. Day 8

    Adrion Island Passage

    The eighth day marks the transition to the third accommodation base. Guests continue the journey aboard a privately organised speedboat, following a scenic Adriatic route that reveals the changing landscapes of the northern Adriatic as the journey gradually transitions from the Opatija Riviera towards the islands of Krk, Cres and Lošinj. Swimming stops, regional dining and time at sea transform the transfer itself into one of the defining experiences of the Grand Tour. Meanwhile, the Dedicated Professional Driver transfers the Mercedes-Benz vehicle, luggage and bicycles via Krk, the Valbiska–Merag ferry, Cres and Osor, ensuring everything is prepared before the guests arrive.

  9. Day 9

    Lošinj

    The final full day is dedicated to the island landscapes of Lošinj. Premium Full-Suspension Electric Mountain Bikes (E-MTBs) provide a relaxed way to explore Čikat, Mali Lošinj, Veli Lošinj and the island's coastal scenery before concluding the journey with a carefully selected farewell dinner.

  10. Day 10

    Continue Your Journey

    Following breakfast, the programme concludes with a private Mercedes-Benz transfer from Mali Lošinj. Depending on your onward travel plans, Adrion will arrange transportation to your selected airport, another Croatian region or the next stage of your personalised itinerary, allowing the Grand Tour to continue seamlessly beyond Kvarner.

What's included

  • — Private departure organised exclusively for your group
  • — Luxury Mercedes-Benz V-Class, or a Sprinter for larger private groups, with a professional driver
  • — Nine nights across carefully selected Istrian, coastal and island accommodation
  • — Western and central Istria — the coastal towns, hill villages, vineyards and olive groves
  • — Two private Adriatic experiences with professional skipper, in Istria and in Kvarner
  • — Učka Nature Park, the Opatija Riviera, Rijeka and the island passage to Lošinj
  • — Dedicated Adrion Travel Host and carefully selected regional dining throughout
  • — All meals throughout the journey
  • — A detailed day-by-day itinerary, provided on request

Questions

+ Is this a private journey?

Yes. Every departure is organised exclusively for the guests travelling together — private transportation, a dedicated Adrion Travel Host and journey coordination arranged for your group alone.

+ How demanding is it?

Previous mountain-biking experience is not required. Premium full-suspension E-MTBs and carefully selected routes let guests of ordinary fitness cover the terrain comfortably, and routes are adapted to the group.

+ Can the itinerary be adjusted?

The overall structure of the journey remains consistent, while selected elements may be adapted according to travel dates, weather and sea conditions, seasonal opportunities and individual preferences.

+ What accommodation is used?

Accommodation is proposed individually — boutique hotels, carefully selected coastal properties, heritage properties or private villas — matched to your travel dates, group size and preferences.

Culture · Gastronomy

Zagreb History & Lifestyle E-Bike Tour

From €220 per person

Discover Zagreb beyond the conventional city tour. Ride through the historic streets of Gradec and Kaptol with a licensed local guide, historian and archaeologist, experience the contemporary culinary character of the city at NOEL Street, then leave the historic centre behind for a relaxed e-bike ride through the lakes and wooded landscapes of Maksimir. With Adrion Premium Full-Suspension E-Bikes, private Mercedes-Benz transportation and complete journey logistics handled throughout, the experience connects Zagreb’s history, gastronomy and green spaces in one carefully paced private journey.

The day

  1. Morning

    Historic Zagreb

    Begin with private collection from your accommodation before setting out on Adrion’s premium e-bikes with your local historian and archaeologist. Explore the relationship between Gradec and Kaptol, Zagreb’s historic streets and squares, architectural layers and the stories that shaped the city.

  2. Midday

    Contemporary Zagreb

    Pause for a curated gastronomic experience at NOEL Street. While you enjoy a different expression of Zagreb, Adrion handles the bicycles and prepares the next stage of your journey.

  3. Afternoon

    Zagreb’s Green Side

    Continue privately to Maksimir, where your e-bikes are ready for a change of pace. Ride between lakes, wooded avenues and open park landscapes before Adrion takes care of the equipment and your private return.

What's included

  • — Private hotel pick-up and return, with Mercedes-Benz transportation
  • — Adrion premium full-suspension e-bikes, helmets and full bicycle logistics
  • — Licensed local guide — historian and archaeologist
  • — A curated gastronomic experience
  • — Complete Adrion journey coordination
  • — Selected photographs captured during the journey
  • — All meals throughout the journey
  • — A detailed day-by-day itinerary, provided on request

Questions

+ Is this a private experience?

Yes. Every departure is organised exclusively for the guests travelling together — private Mercedes-Benz transportation, licensed local guiding and complete Adrion journey coordination arranged for your group alone.

+ Do I need cycling experience?

No. Adrion operates its own premium full-suspension e-bikes with 800 Wh batteries, and routes are selected according to the confidence of the group, the weather and trail conditions. Guests should be comfortable riding a bicycle independently; advanced mountain-biking experience is not required.

Approximately five hours, beginning with a private pick-up from your Zagreb accommodation and concluding with a private return.

History · Gastronomy · Nature · E-bike adventure

Adrion Signature E-Bike Tour

From €330 per person

Discover Zagreb from its historic streets to the forests and viewpoints of Medvednica in one privately curated full-day journey. The Adrion Signature E-Bike Tour brings together the elements that define the city particularly well — history, gastronomy, nature and movement — and connects them in a journey that gradually moves from the heart of Zagreb to the mountain above it. Begin by exploring the historic city on Adrion Premium Full-Suspension E-Bikes, accompanied by a licensed local guide, historian and archaeologist. Discover Gradec and Kaptol, Zagreb's architectural layers and the stories that shaped the Croatian capital. The morning concludes with a curated gastronomic experience at Dubravkin Put, set beside the forested landscape of Tuškanac and included in the MICHELIN Guide selection. From there, leave the city behind and ascend Medvednica by cable car. At Sljeme, urban Zagreb gives way to mountain landscapes before the journey continues by e-bike through the forests of Medvednica towards medieval Medvedgrad, Šestine and Cmrok. Private Mercedes-Benz transportation, premium e-bikes and complete journey logistics are coordinated throughout by Adrion. This is not simply a Zagreb city tour followed by a mountain excursion. It is one continuous journey through the relationship between city, mountain and history.

The day

  1. Morning

    Discovering Historic Zagreb

    Your journey begins with private collection from your Zagreb accommodation. After individual e-bike preparation, helmet fitting and a short briefing, you meet your private local guide and begin exploring the historical heart of the city. The route connects Ban Jelačić Square, the Cathedral District, Gradec and Kaptol, Stone Gate, the Upper Town and St. Mark's Square, together with selected historic streets, courtyards and architectural details. Short walking sections are incorporated where appropriate. With a historian and archaeologist leading the experience, the emphasis extends beyond individual monuments. The relationship between Gradec and Kaptol, Zagreb's development and the people and events that shaped the city provide the context for understanding what you encounter along the way.

  2. Midday

    Dubravkin Put

    The morning concludes at Dubravkin Put. Surrounded by the greenery of Tuškanac yet close to the historic centre, the setting marks a natural transition in the journey. Enjoy a curated gastronomic experience at this MICHELIN Guide–selected restaurant while Adrion takes care of the bicycles and prepares the mountain section. The pace slows. The city portion of the journey is complete, and Medvednica comes next.

  3. Early afternoon

    Above Zagreb

    Private Mercedes-Benz transportation takes you towards the Zagreb cable car. The ascent provides a period of rest and a gradual transition from city to mountain. At Sljeme, there is time to experience the summit landscape and selected viewpoints. Where included and available, the journey incorporates the Observation Tower before the afternoon cycling begins.

  4. Afternoon

    Through Medvednica

    Your Adrion e-bike is prepared for the mountain section. The journey now continues through selected forest routes and natural landscapes of Medvednica. Depending on the group and conditions, the route may combine forest roads, suitable trails, quieter mountain sections and viewpoints. This is a more active experience than Adrion's half-day Zagreb e-bike tour, but advanced mountain-biking experience is not required. The route is selected to create the right balance between landscape, movement, comfort and discovery.

  5. Late afternoon

    Medvedgrad

    The mountain route reconnects with Zagreb's history at Medvedgrad. Explore the medieval fortress with your guide and discover the historical significance of its position above the city. From here, the relationship between Zagreb and Medvednica — experienced throughout the day — becomes particularly clear.

  6. Evening

    Returning to Zagreb

    The final section gradually leaves the mountain behind and returns towards the city through Šestine and Cmrok. Forest landscapes transition into traditional neighbourhoods and open urban green spaces. The pace becomes deliberately easier as the journey approaches its conclusion. Adrion collects the bicycles and equipment before private Mercedes-Benz transportation returns you to your accommodation.

  • — Adrion premium full-suspension e-bikes, helmets and full bicycle logistics
  • — Licensed local guide — historian and archaeologist
  • — Signature gastronomic experience at a MICHELIN Guide–selected restaurant
  • — Cable car ascent and admissions throughout the day
  • — Complete Adrion journey coordination
  • — Selected photographs captured during the journey
  • — All meals throughout the journey
  • — A detailed day-by-day itinerary, provided on request

Yes. Every departure is organised exclusively for the guests travelling together — private Mercedes-Benz transportation, licensed local guiding and complete Adrion journey coordination arranged for your group alone.

+ Do I need mountain-biking experience?

No. Adrion operates its own premium full-suspension e-bikes with 800 Wh batteries, and routes are selected according to the confidence of the group, the weather and trail conditions. Guests should be comfortable riding a bicycle independently; advanced mountain-biking experience is not required.

Castles · Baroque heritage · Gastronomy · Prehistory

Trakošćan, Varaždin & Krapina Journey

€230 per person, based on a private group of 6

Travel north from Zagreb through the landscapes and history of northern Croatia. Explore Trakošćan Castle with a licensed historian and archaeologist, discover the baroque character of Varaždin, pause among the vineyards of Varaždin Breg for a curated gastronomic experience at Zlatne Gorice, and conclude in Krapina, where archaeology takes the story back to the world of the Neanderthals. Four distinct perspectives. One privately curated journey through time.

The day

  1. Morning

    Trakošćan Castle

    Begin among the green landscapes of Hrvatsko Zagorje at Trakošćan Castle. Explore its historic interiors, collections and architecture while your private guide introduces the people and periods connected with the castle and its wider cultural landscape.

  2. Midday

    Baroque Varaždin

    Continue to Varaždin, where castle landscapes give way to historic streets, squares and baroque architecture. Discover the historic centre, Old Town and fortifications, palaces and selected landmarks through a privately guided walking experience.

  3. Early afternoon

    Gastronomy & Wine at Zlatne Gorice

    Leave the city for the vineyards of Varaždin Breg. At Zlatne Gorice, the pace slows for a curated regional gastronomic experience accompanied by selected wine. Where arranged in advance, a cellar experience and more detailed introduction to regional wines can complement the meal.

  4. Afternoon

    Krapina & the Neanderthals

    The final chapter takes the journey much further into the past. Visit the Krapina Neanderthal Museum and explore human evolution, prehistoric life and the archaeological discoveries associated with Krapina. Accompanied by a historian and archaeologist, this becomes more than a museum visit — it completes the historical narrative of the day.

What's included

  • — Private hotel pick-up and return, with Mercedes-Benz transportation
  • — Licensed local guide — historian and archaeologist
  • — Castle and museum admissions throughout the day
  • — Curated regional gastronomy with selected wine
  • — Complete Adrion journey coordination
  • — Selected photographs captured during the journey
  • — All meals throughout the journey
  • — A detailed day-by-day itinerary, provided on request
